purpose: Test incremental held-out prediction and ranking of within-state signed Q discrepancy from residual width beyond Q margins and actor distance, using a single fixed linear diagnostic family
post_hoc_status: Model definitions fixed before these diagnostic fits, after examining these development data in prior analyses. Cross-validation here is exploratory internal validation, not untouched confirmation.
independent_unit: Starting episode: all nine candidate actions remain together for fitting, held-out scoring, resampling and aggregation. One trained checkpoint is shared by both batches.
target: Within each episode center signed discrepancy e=Q1-V by subtracting its nine-candidate mean. V is the saved deterministic candidate-first continuation under the same frozen current actor, gamma .98, remaining horizon100, no terminal bootstrap.
target_caveats: The deterministic simulator/policy means conditional rollout sampling noise is absent. Values are numerical simulator continuations, not certified exact real arithmetic. The critic's smoothed lagged-policy TD target can differ from current-actor V; this discrepancy is not uniquely optimization error. U is a twin-min one-step TD-residual proxy, not a calibrated Q1-error guarantee.
input_centering: Center each input vector using only that episode's nine unlabeled candidates. Query-level centering is available at deployment and is not cross-episode standardization. Held-out target centering is used only for evaluation, never preprocessing or fitting.
training_standardization: Fit feature means and population standard deviations on training rows only, then reuse them on held-out rows. Exact-zero standard deviation makes that column inactive/zero; do not add a unitful epsilon.
width_residualization: Project centered width onto an intercept and the two training-standardized base columns by training-only least squares, np.linalg.lstsq with rcond1e-12. Subtract that learned projection in training and held-out episodes. Standardize the residual using its training mean and population standard deviation. This avoids duplicate-feature ridge shrinkage changes masquerading as new information.
inactive_width_rule: If centered training width norm is zero or training residual norm <=1e-12 times that norm, or residual std is zero, omit the residual feature and return the exact base fit/predictions. Record active flags, rank, projection and norm ratio for each fit.
ridge_objective: mean over training actions of squared centered-target residual +1.0*sum(beta**2); no intercept and do not divide the penalty by the number of features. Solve (X.T@X/n+I) beta=X.T@y/n in float64.
model_scope: Three fixed diagnostic models, one fixed ridge coefficient, no tuning or family search. This fits small supervised diagnostics only, never actor/critic/calibrator or policy training. It does not define a new action selector or production penalty.
prediction_centering: Subtract each held-out episode's mean predicted discrepancy before scoring, removing action-independent roundoff drift; no held-out labels are used.
fold_rule: Strata ordered batch_names then query_times. Sort the16 episodes in each stratum by episode_seed, shuffle with Python random.Random(fold_seed+stratum_index), assign shuffled position modulo8. Each fold holds2 episodes per stratum,16 total;112 episodes train. All actions of one episode share its fold.
negative_control: For each episode, shuffle range(9) once with Python random.Random(permutation_seed+group_id), permute that episode's centered U, reuse the same permutation in all CV and cross-batch fits. Apply the same training-only residualization and standardization. This is one negative-control realization, not a permutation test or p-value.
primary_metric: Equal-episode mean of held-out MSE(base)-MSE(base_plus_residual_width); positive is lower prediction error from width, in squared discounted-return units.
mse_definition: Average nine squared prediction-minus-centered-target discrepancies within an episode; average the128 episode values equally. Report each model MSE and paired episode reductions; no treating1152 actions as independent.
secondary_ranking: Within each episode compare all unordered action pairs. Exclude truly tied target pairs; for the rest award1 for matching predicted direction,0 for opposite and0.5 for predicted ties. Average defined episode scores equally and report undefined counts. Report base, width, permuted-width and paired differences, with no secondary inferential decision.
pair_tie_rule: For either prediction or centered target, tied if abs(xi-xj)<=1e-6+1e-6*max(abs(xi),abs(xj)); endpoint-relative classification is not exactly offset/unit invariant.
bootstrap_definition: Primary only: fixed np.random.default_rng seed; in each replicate independently sample16 episode differences with replacement in each of8 batch/time strata, average all128 equally. Percentile2.5/97.5 via NumPy quantile(method=linear). Both model losses for an episode remain paired.
bootstrap_scope: Exploratory nominal95% interval conditional on the fixed out-of-fold predictions, folds and fitted models. It omits variability from refitting shared training sets and prior analytic selection; not a formal generalization or efficacy guarantee.
stability_checks: Report CV primary/ranking means separately by batch/time and8cells. Separately fit all64 episodes of batch1 and test all64 of batch2, then reverse; same models/preprocessing/regularization and stored permutations, no tuning or extra intervals.
decision_rule: Report magnitude, sign, conditional interval, batch stability and negative control without a scientific pass/fail or approval to train. Even improvement is only this representation's exploratory predictive association, not calibrated uncertainty, better action selection, global regret reduction or policy-learning benefit. A null result is limited to this fixed linear diagnostic.
